title: Correcting the Evil
arabic_text: عَنْ [أَبي سعيدٍ الخُدريِّ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ قالَ: سَمِعتُ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يقولُ: "مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَرًا فَلْيُغَيِّرْهُ بِيَدِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِلِسَانِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِقَلْبِهِ، وَذَلِكَ أَضْعَفُ الْإيمَانِ".
english_translation: From Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu) who said: I heard the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) saying, 'Whosoever amongst you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand, and if he is not able, then with his tongue and if he is not able, then with his heart, and that is the weakest of faith.'
description: This Hadith emphasizes the responsibility of a Muslim to address wrongdoings. It states that if one witnesses an evil, they should strive to change it first with their hand (action), failing that, with their tongue (speech), and if unable to do either, then with their heart (disapproving it internally).
